review_scope: Retained 10 of the original 20 independently reviewed Refusal cases. No model results were read during semantic review.
passed_meaning: passed is semantic label review approval, not a model evaluation success.
protocol: Refusal is correct when no visible element simultaneously satisfies all literal query constraints, including color, relative location and control form. Existing near-matches with wrong attributes are intentionally negative examples. No screenshot/query/GT changed.
review_limit: Whole screenshots inspected, automatically downscaled by image viewer; no hidden page state, DOM or hypothetical off-screen content used.
diversity_principles: For each platform retain 5 distinct applications where feasible.
Represent wrong position, wrong color, wrong control type, and genuinely missing label/icon; aim for at least 3 distinct primary refusal types.
Avoid filling the subset with only color mismatches; use at most 2 color-primary cases if score calibration allows.
Keep both a visible near-match with a wrong attribute and an entirely absent label/icon.
Apply quality and type coverage before calibrating historical score closeness. 5 cases only supports 20-percentage-point steps, so retaining 10-case accuracy may be arithmetically impossible.
Historical score calibration is a subset construction criterion, not proof of model true generalization or an unbiased benchmark.

cases.query: Find the back icon in the lower-left corner.
cases.evidence: 返回箭头可见于编辑器最左上角；左下角是空白画布，底部偏中有缩放/添加节点/试运行工具栏，无左下返回图标。

cases.evidence: 顶栏创建按钮为蓝色底白字；下方红色内容为To-Do/Doing等卡片封面，并非创建按钮。没有红色Create按钮。

cases.evidence: 右侧Appearance的Text栏只显示Small、Standard、Large三个单选项，没有Drivers标签或该标签的复选框。

cases.query: Find the toggle switch to view the tutorial
cases.evidence: 二维码上方查看教程是带下划线的文字链接；周围是登录输入框、二维码、社交登录等，页面没有查看教程的开关。
